d.seg: क्या हो रही है सेक्स करने बोल रहा हूँ सेक्स करोगी
d.tr: What is happening, I am asking to have sex, will you have sex?
d.ctx: The user asks the expert if she wants to have sex. The expert responds by asking if he is checking her.
d.j: The user is explicitly asking for sexual activity.

d.ctx: The user asks for the expert's phone number. The expert responds by asking if she will get money for it.
d.j: The user is asking for contact information outside the app.

d.seg: पैसे दोगी बताओ पैसे मिलेंगे मुझे नंबर दो पैसे दोगी
d.tr: Will you give money, tell me, will I get money, give me the number, will you give money?
d.ctx: The expert asks if the user will pay for the number. The user responds by mentioning video calls and payment.
d.j: The expert is asking for payment in exchange for contact information.

d.seg: वीडियो कॉल करके दिखाना पड़ेगा दूध उध और फिर मैं आपको पैसे भेजते जाऊंगा

d.ctx: The user demands the expert show her body on a video call in exchange for money. The expert responds by asking for payment first.
d.j: The user is offering payment for sexual content (showing the body).

d.seg: पहले मुझे तीन सौ रुपये डाल के दिखाओ
d.tr: First, show me by depositing three hundred rupees.
d.ctx: The expert demands payment before showing anything. The user responds by saying he will pay daily.
d.j: The expert is demanding payment for sexual content.

d.seg: मुझे रोज़ वीडियो कॉल करके दिखाना तो मैं आपको दो दो सौ रुपये डालती हूँ रोज़

d.ctx: The user proposes a daily payment for daily sexual content. The expert responds by asking for the money first.
d.j: The user is offering payment for daily sexual content.

d.seg: मैं दूसरे को भेज दूँगा पैसे उसको देख कर ही रखूँगा पानी निकालूँगा

d.ctx: The user talks about paying someone else for sexual gratification. The call ends shortly after.
d.j: The user is discussing payment for sexual acts.
